scoring_justification: All quantities are fixed analytic results of the Debye model; the checker recomputes them from the same formulas and compares with exact-match tolerance, no trust in agent-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Exact analytic Mori parameters and Laplace transforms for Debye isotropic solid
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Debye model formulas from the paper: spectral moments, recurrence for Δ_i², Φ̂₀(0)=π/(2ω_D), recurrence for γ_i; displacement Laplace=π/(2ω_D), velocity Laplace=0.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed from formulas: Δ₁²/ω_D²=1/3, Δ₂²=4/15, Δ₃²=9/35, Δ₄²=16/63; γ₁/ω_D=π/6, γ₂=8/(5π), γ₃=9π/56, γ₄=128/(81π); displacement Laplace/ω_D=π/2, velocity Laplace/ω_D=0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are fixed deterministic quantities derived from the public Debye model; a correct re-derivation yields exactly these numbers.

outputs.description: Dimensionless Mori chain coupling coefficients Δ_i²/ω_D² and damping coefficients γ_i/ω_D for the displacement operator.
Zero-frequency Laplace transforms of the displacement and velocity autocorrelation functions, expressed as dimensionless ratios relative to ω_D.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are dimensionless ratios derived from the Debye model within the high-temperature classical limit. The values are uniquely determined by the public problem definition; exact analytic comparison is performed by the hidden checker.

steps.note: Each field compared to exact rational/pi-based gold within 1e-6
